title: clyops-jobs config
description: Functions bound to clyops tools, their default options and their option blocks. Every other top-level key is an options block, named by a function's or step's `key`.

functions.description: The functions a trigger can run, by name.

defaults.description: Default options by block key, merged under the block of the same key.

template.description: Text with `${dot.path}` or `{{dot.path}}` templates rendered against the trigger's context (`job`, `paths`, `params`, `steps`, ...).

options.description: Tool options keyed like the tool's options (`out_dir` or `out-dir`) or arguments, mapped onto its command line through --help-json-schema. String values are templates; an option naming a missing `params` field is left unset.

key.description: The options block (a top-level key and a `defaults` key); default: the function's or step's name.

script.description: The tool, relative to the script root.

positionals.description: The tool's positional arguments as templates, in order; `[]` for none. Without it, arguments are options keyed by argument name.

positionals_order.description: Positionals before (default) or after the options.

stdin.description: A template naming the file fed to the tool's stdin, relative to the config root.

stdout.description: A template naming the file the tool's stdout is written to, relative to `paths.work_dir`.

strict_params.description: A missing `params` field is an error instead of leaving the option unset (default false).

^x-.description: Free for triggers and comments; clyops-jobs ignores it.

function.description: A function runs one tool (`script`) or several in order (`steps`).

steps.description: Tools run in order with one context; each step's outputs are `steps.NAME` (`exit_code`, `stdout`, `result`, `meta`, `progress`, `error`) in the templates after it.

result.description: Templates added to the result record; nested objects and arrays are rendered too.

name.description: Names the step in `${steps.NAME...}` templates, branches and errors.

timeout_ms.description: This step's time limit; the whole chain also stays within the run's timeoutMs.

continue_on_exit.description: Exit codes besides 0 that count as success; the chain then reports the first of them, e.g. [2] for a partial result.

succeed.description: The later step to run after this one succeeds, instead of the next; `$end` ends the chain.

fail.description: The later step to run when this one exits nonzero or times out, instead of ending the chain.

error.description: The later step to run when this one can't start (a template, stdin or schema error), instead of failing the run.

artifacts.description: Files copied from `paths.work_dir` into `paths.artifacts_dir` after the run: glob patterns (`*`, `?`, `**`), or an object with them and a requirement.

required.description: At least one file must match.

min.description: At least this many files must match.
